context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: インフラ/漁港/眠れる/疲労/行列/砂漠/丘/霧

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、街の、絶対、インフラ、絶対、整備、絶対、よくなってきたわよね
lines.en: You know, Sho, the town's infrastructure really has been improving lately.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle cadence. The voice of someone noticing small good things in ordinary life. Slight rise at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、漁港、絶対、で、絶対、お魚、絶対、買ってきたって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa bought fish from the harbor this morning!
lines.style: Bright and eager, the quick speech of a six-year-old sharing news. Eyes wide. Not asking for permission to be excited—just being it. Natural child energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、夜ちゃんと、絶対、眠れる、絶対、？本気で
lines.en: Sho, are you sleeping okay at night?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry beneath the surface. A mother's quiet worry softened into a question. Unhurried. The tone of someone checking on someone she loves, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お仕事の、絶対、疲労、絶対、たまってるみたいだよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom, I think Dad's been really tired from work lately.
lines.style: Quiet perceptiveness. Small, steady voice. The kind of thing a sensitive child notices and mentions matter-of-factly, without drama. Slight responsibility in the tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ラーメン屋さん、本気で、絶対、行列、絶対、すごいわよね、翔くん
lines.en: The ramen shop had such a long line today, didn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Light, conversational. The voice of someone making small talk about the day. Bright but not forced. A moment of shared noticing between mother and child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、テレビで、絶対、砂漠、絶対、見たよ、ママ
lines.en: I saw a desert on TV yesterday, Mom.
lines.style: Simple, direct child speech. Pleased with the sharing. No elaboration needed—just stating a fact that seemed interesting. Genuine, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんちは、本気で、絶対、丘、絶対、の上にあるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandpa's house sits right up on top of the hill, you know.
lines.style: Gentle teaching quality. Speaking as if showing him something familiar from a slightly different angle. Warm, unhurried. A mother's voice describing home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、今朝、絶対、霧、絶対、すごかったよね
lines.en: The mist was really thick this morning, wasn't it, Mom?
lines.style: Bright observation. Child's enthusiasm for noticing something about the day. Ending on warmth and shared recognition, looking back at the morning together.
